turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
turns.replyTail:
Most orders are shipped from our warehouse within 1 to 2 business days. Once your order has been shipped, you will receive a tracking number via email or SMS. Please keep in mind that it can take up to 3 business days for the tracking information to update after the package has been sent.

I would love to check the status of your specific order! Could you please share your order number and the email address you used? 🙂

turns.q: What should I do if the tracking never updates?
turns.replyTail:
If your tracking doesn't update for a while, don't worry! Sometimes it can take a few business days for the carrier to scan the package and update their system.

If there has been no movement for over 8 days for US/Canada orders (or 15 days for international), please let us know so we can look into it for you. 🙂

In the meantime, could you please provide your order number and the email address you used at checkout? I'd love to check the current status of your order!
